title: Text Volume Chapter 590 Zongheng
content:
Text Volume Chapter 590 Zongheng

"Good on you Kuai Che."

Kuai Che lived in a single family on the outskirts of Fanyang City. As soon as he entered the house, an old voice said coldly: "You violated the law of holding books and hid so many banned books."

But under the pear tree in his yard, he saw a white-haired old man sitting cross-legged on the ground. The wooden box buried under the tree was dug out. Inside were dozens of bamboo slips. The old man was looking through it with interest...

"An Qisheng, you old man."

Kuai Che, however, was not angry but smiled instead: "It's called taking refuge as a guest, but it's actually a thief. You found out all of this."

The old man sitting in the courtyard was actually An Qisheng, who was on Zhifu Island in Jiaodong County and accused the First Emperor of Qin of seeking immortals. The warlocks in the rear were tricked and put on the wanted list...

An Qisheng and Kuai Che are old acquaintances. More than ten years ago, Kuai Che traveled all over the country and by chance, rescued An Qisheng who was being chased by his enemies. Only he knew that this so-called "immortal" was actually just a declining old man. Not to mention immortal, he would bleed profusely when stabbed by an enemy with a sword. He begged himself to save his life, but it was only afterwards that he could not stop bleeding. He changed his identity again, pretending to be a ghost, claiming that he was invulnerable to swords and halberds.

Now that Warlock Fang has suffered, An Qisheng has also been implicated. He can no longer stay in Qidi, so he can only run to Yandi and take shelter with his old friend Kuai Che for a while. Most of the things about the upper echelons of the Qin Dynasty were told to Kuai by An Qisheng. Thorough.

Kuai Che was out for the past few days, and An Qisheng was bored at his house. He walked under the pear tree and pushed aside the fallen leaves after piling up the old leaves. He found that the soil underneath was renovated, so he felt moved and tried to dig a few times. I really found out Kuai Che’s little secret.

These books are really 100% banned books, they are called "National Policy", or "State Affairs", or "Short and Long", or "Shi Yu", or "Long Book", or "Replying Books". They are all stories about the strategies of strategists in the past hundreds of years. Unlike poems and books that are collected, deleted, adapted, and tampered with, once these political strategists who teach people to play tricks and deceit are exposed, not only will the books be burned, but Kuai Che himself will not be able to live with it!

Kuai Che walked over, picked up the books one by one, read them, and sighed: "I was born at the wrong time. These books could have been brilliant, but now they can only be sealed in boxes and hidden underground, unknown to anyone. "

"You, Kuai Che, are just like this book. You were born at the wrong time, so why did you go to the young master Fusu to give advice?"

An Qisheng leaned against the pear tree and smiled: "But I don't believe that you really want to assist Fusu and treat him as your sycamore branch. Tell me, what is your plan for this treacherous strategist?"

Although Kuai Che only said he was "visiting friends" when he went out, An Qisheng could guess what he was doing when he helped Su Shuaibing stationed in Fan Yang recently with his eyes closed.

I can only guess the real purpose of Kuai Che doing all this.

Also, who exactly is he working for?

Kuai Che did not answer immediately, but brought out a jar of pear wine in the house, filled it for An Qi Sheng, sat opposite each other, and said with a smile: "Businesses and sales come and go, everyone gets what they need. If you tell me, you can I’ll tell you my purpose once Warlock Alchemist plans it.”

"I?"

An Qisheng didn't look like the immortal on Zhifu Island at all. He smiled helplessly: "You have seen me almost dying. I was just making a fool of myself, pretending to be an immortal for a living, but the lies got bigger and bigger, and finally I had to You old man, keep on acting."

"It's not just you."

Kuai Che asked to the end.

"Lu Ao, Han Zhong, Hou Sheng, Xu Fu and others, what is their purpose in approaching Qin Shi Huangdi?"

An Qisheng pondered, the magician Fang was defeated, those who were killed were killed, and those who fled fled. Now, there is nothing to hide.

"Hou Sheng is obsessed with immortality, and what he is greedy for is the emperor's financial support, so that he can refine the true elixir; Han Zhong is a member of the Han family, just like Zheng Guo, and is Han's spy. He wants to avenge Han, but he has not been found for a long time. Take advantage of the opportunity; Xu Fu is a solitary person. He hopes to deceive the emperor and take the boys and girls overseas, so that he can become a prince in the future..."

Although this group came together to plan, their purposes were different.

"As for Lu Ao?"

An Qisheng took a sip of wine and said with a smile: "Lu Ao is very ambitious. He hopes to confuse the emperor with Fang Xiandao, and then control his words and deeds, stay away from the ministers, and become a real loner, only listening to the advice of Fang Warlock." Say. In this way, he can transform into the great witch of the country, control power and govern the world in the name of seeking immortality for the emperor!"

"Separate the emperor from the ministers and profit from it? The ambition is really not small. It's a pity that you missed a move and failed in Jiaodong."

Kuai Che laughed at the other warlock, while An Qisheng stared at him: "I'm done, what about you? Your plot is probably not small!"

Kuai Che sighed: "I don't have any conspiracy. I just heard that Young Master Fusu came all the way and shared food and clothing with the soldiers. He won the hearts of the soldiers. Even the Zhao people who hated Qin had to admit that this The young master is quite kind."

"I thought that Fusu had strategic ambitions and was deliberately trying to win people's hearts, so I went to see him. If I could help him, I would advise him on military strategies, win his trust, and stay by his side as his mastermind. With the strange strategies I learned Wisdom can be used as capital according to the situation, and it can be painted according to the time. This is the horizontal ability; it can support the emergency, turn danger into safety, and turn fate into survival. This is the vertical ability. With the vertical and horizontal skills, he can help him in the battle for the inheritance. To stand out and become an emperor is to live up to a lifetime of learning.”

Kuai Che studied the art of Zongheng, a school that was once prominent, but after the unification of the Qin Dynasty, it was completely useless and gradually declined.

"But when I saw him in person and listened to his words, I realized that this boy is really rotten wood and dung. He cannot be used as a weapon or put on a wall! Sharing food and clothing with soldiers is not about buying people's hearts, but the kindness of women. It is not very pleasing to the people. The soldiers of Zhao, however, embarrassed the soldiers of Qin.”

"What's even more stupid is that he has a sword in his hand, but he hands the hilt to others, with the sword tip facing himself, hoping that the father and son will be filial. How could Qin Shi Huang, who has a tiger and wolf heart, give birth to such a cowardly son? Although he has a reputation for benevolence, he cannot accomplish anything. This is the kind of person we, the political elite, despise and hate the most!"

"then."

Kuai Che raised his head with a sinister smile: "Since he is destined to be unable to fly and cannot be assisted, I will simply come up with a bad idea and push him closer to the cliff."

After hearing Kuai Che's idea, An Qisheng laughed loudly: "You really want to put Fusu to death! No matter whether he accepts it or not, as long as today's incident spreads and reaches the emperor's ears, your estrangement will If you make a plan, it will be done.”

Kuai Che shook his head: "It takes less than a day to freeze three feet. It's certainly not that simple to separate a monarch and his subjects, father and son. But the emperor and his son, called father and son, are actually monarchs and subjects, and they are extraordinary. As the saying goes, closeness leads to closeness. , Far away leads to sparseness. The emperor always goes on tour without Fusu. Now Fusu is on an expedition to a foreign land and will not be able to return for a year and a half. Do you think that without me, there will be no rumors and slander in Xianyang? The other princes will not compete for the throne. What's on your mind? I'm just adding some ingredients to it."

"When the emperor heard that his eldest son, who was serving as a general outside, had won the hearts of the Yan and Zhao scholars, and even had advisers join him and give him advice, wouldn't he feel a pang in his heart? Over time, he might become disloyal..."

If at first, Kuai Che really just wanted to see what kind of person Fusu was and help him if he could, then after Fusu kicked him out, Kuai Che quickly changed his mind.

An Qisheng still couldn't react. Just a moment ago, hadn't Kuai Che vowed to help Fusu and help him turn danger into safety and turn fate into survival? Why did he suddenly change his mind and put him to death!

As everyone knows, this group of strategists, contrary to ordinary people, do not follow their heads but their butts, but their butts follow their heads...

"You really want Qin to be in chaos."

An Qisheng sighed: "To be honest, who are you looking for? A certain Young Master Yan who is hiding among the people and wants to restore the country? Or the heroic hero Lu Goujian who rebelled in Julu County? Or is it the Lord Canghai who is in danger across the sea? "

"neither!"

Kuai Che spread his hands and said: "Gongsun Yan first served as the prime minister of Qin and captured the land west of the Wei River for Qin. Then he became the prime minister of Wei and Han, presiding over the five kingdoms' joint attack on Qin. He even contacted Yiqu to make King Qin Hui suffer from enemies from both sides. It’s so embarrassing. Who is he working for? Qin? Wei? Han? "

"And Chen Zhen was once a traveler of Qin, a traveler of Chu, and even more a traveler of Qi. It can be said that he served Qin and even Chu. Who is he working for? Qin, Chu or Qi?"

Without waiting for An Qisheng's reply, Kuai Che said loudly:

"No, they are all arrogant people who only seek things for themselves!"

Kuai Che stood up proudly: "If there is no verticality, then there is no horizontality, and if there is no horizontality, there is no verticality. The horizontal can be turned into vertical, and the vertical can be turned into horizontal! This is the true meaning of vertical and horizontal!"

"I, Kuai Che, have learned the art of San Su Zong Heng. Can't I do things for myself?"

An Qisheng understood that most of the various schools of thought longed for peace in the world and that their knowledge could lead to governance. Only this strategist did not seek to govern the world. The other generation could only be a trend-setter in troubled times!

In particular, Kuai Che's tactics focus on destabilizing danger and conspiracy. The specific implementation method is to disrupt the situation, and then win and profit from the chaos. This is a very terrifying knowledge. If you are not careful, you will be in danger. If you don't have the courage far beyond ordinary people, and don't have the ability to stay calm in chaos, I'm afraid you won't be able to master it.

But Kuai Che was very obsessed with this exciting knowledge, almost to the point of obsession.

But what was helpless was that when he finished his studies, the five hundred and fifty years of chaos were coming to an end. Qin's sweep of Liuhe was unstoppable. The situation became increasingly clear. The troubled times were over and the era of great unification was coming.

The most useless person in a peaceful environment is probably the political strategist. Not to mention, the Qin Dynasty also strictly restricted the lobbyists who lobbied everywhere, and listed the words of political strategists as banned books and burned them all.

Kuai Che, who had no talent, had no choice but to work hard and waste his time. He hoped that he could be like Zhang Yi, Su Qin, and Gongsun Yan, who worked hard and made great achievements. He didn't ask for titles, but only wanted to leave a glimpse in this world!

But if the world is not in chaos, how can the powerful and powerful people come to the fore?

Fusu's arrival is an opportunity to encourage him to seize the throne, or even fight for the throne in the future. The art of vertical and horizontal will definitely come in handy.

But since Fusu was expected to be unavailable, Kuai Che decided to use him to bring chaos to the world!

Kuai Che said: "The uprising in the fields of Qi seems to be booming, but what is the result? It was suppressed in less than three months. This incident is enough to show that as long as Qin Shihuang does not die and the center of the imperial court is not in chaos, he wants to destroy it from the outside. How easy is it to conquer the mighty Qin Dynasty?"

"But Qin Shihuang was too conceited and still had no desire to live forever. He has not established a prince for a long time. If Fusu, who is most likely to succeed to the throne, is also suspected, exiled, or even sentenced to death, then after the emperor's death, the central government will be in chaos. Then all the heroes in the world will rise up one after another, and the world will be in chaos again!"

Some people hope that nothing will happen in the world, while others are afraid that the world will not be in chaos!

For strategists, the best era is not when horses are released in Nanshan, when there is no war, and there is orderly order between the young and the old.

For them, the best era should be to sacrifice gifts and favor war, and to abandon benevolence and righteousness in favor of deceit.

This is a usurper and robber, and he is ranked as a prince; a country of deceit and treachery becomes strong!

There is no emperor above, no magistrate below. If you compete with others for strength, the winner will be right! The war is endless, and fraud and counterfeiting are on the rise!

That's the stage for the talented people to shine!

One word makes a country prosper, another word destroys it; the country where you live is important, but the country you go to is light; one word makes the princes fearful, but if you live in peace, the world will rest! This is what a man does!

Just thinking about it made him excited.

As for the violence caused by the war, with bloodshed all over the country, fathers and sons not in love, brothers at odds with each other, and couples separated, how can we not save their lives?

That's what Fusu and Heifu are worried about, what does it have to do with his arrogant people!

Kuai Che drank up the pear wine in the jar, threw it away, buried the dozens of volumes of Zongheng Ce books again, covered them with straw and leaves, and walked into the house.

When he came out again, he had changed his makeup, his beard was gone, his hair style had changed, and he was carrying a robe on his back, as if he had traveled far away.

"Leaving now?"

An Qisheng opened his eyes.

"That's right, I'm leaving."

Although Kuai Che looks crazy and fears that the world will be in chaos, he is extremely calm and clear inside.

"Fusu is confused, but if anyone around him understands and comes to hunt me down, I will die at the hands of a small official."

An Qisheng stood up on crutches. Kuai Che wanted to leave, so he had to leave too and join others: "Where do you want to go?"

Kuai Che asked An Qisheng a question.

"You said where is the warlock Han Zhong who wanted to avenge Han's destruction of Qin after becoming a Korean prince?"

An Qisheng pondered and said, "In Shanggu County."

"Then I will go to Shanggu County!"

Kuai Che said with a smile: "I have an idea. If you want to bring chaos to the world, this person is indispensable!"
